sloka: तस्मिन् काले सुमित्रायाः पुत्रः परबलार्दनः।चकार लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो युद्धं परपुरञ्जयः ।। ६.६७.१०२ ।।
transliteration: tasmin kāle sumitrāyāḥ putraḥ parabalārdanaḥ।cakāra lakṣmaṇaḥ kruddho yuddhaṁ parapurañjayaḥ ।। 6.67.102 ।।

translations.english: At that time, Sumitra's son, Lakshmana, winner of enemy forces, conqueror of forts, enraged went to fight.
